name: Bank of Queensland Limited
summary: Bank of Queensland Limited, together with its subsidiaries, provides financial services in Australia. The company operates through Retail Bank and BOQ Business segments. It offers savings and investment accounts; term deposits; transaction accounts; business bank accounts; debit and credit cards; home and contents, landlord, and car insurance; business banking support products. The company also provides home loans, such as refinancing; business loans, as well as bank guarantee, business overdraft, self-managed super fund loan, and equipment and vehicle finance; and banking solutions for agribusiness, corporate and property, and healthcare.
